notes: IDENTITY is solid; the HOSPITAL AFFILIATION is not, which is why this is Low / Needs Human Review. There is only one such surgeon, not two same-name doctors: Yashoda's page and CARE's page carry the identical training history (MBBS Gandhi Medical College Hyderabad 2002-2007, MS General Surgery Osmania Medical College/Osmania General Hospital 2009-2012, DNB Surgical Oncology Basavatarakam Indo-American Cancer Hospital Hyderabad 2013-2015) and the identical sub-specialty (laparoscopic + robotic onco-surgery), so this is one person appearing on two hospital sites. WHAT MATCHES THE INPUT ROW: name, specialty ('Oncology & Laparoscopic, Robotic Onco-Surgeon' is almost verbatim Yashoda's own wording), city, and the Somajiguda branch - the Yashoda URL path encodes /doctor/somajiguda/surgical-oncology/, which is the strongest available branch evidence. THE PROBLEM: (a) only the Burmese-locale mirror of that Yashoda profile (/my/...) surfaced in three separate searches - the English-language equivalent never appeared, and I did NOT construct it, which is consistent with the English page having been retired while locale mirrors linger; (b) CARE Hospitals publishes him across at least four of its own pages as a CURRENT Consultant Surgical Oncologist at CARE Cancer Institute, Banjara Hills and CARE HITEC City; (c) his own personal website places him at Sunbliz Cancer Clinic and K K Reddy Hospital in KPHB, and both Practo listings put him in KPHB, not Somajiguda; (d) the experience figures line up with a move roughly 4 years ago - 14 years in the input row versus 18 years on CARE's current profile. CONCLUSION FOR A HUMAN: he most likely LEFT Yashoda Somajiguda for CARE Hospitals, and the Yashoda row is stale. I have recorded the Yashoda page as hospital_profile only because it genuinely is the named hospital's own official page with the correct branch in the path - it is NOT another hospital's page being passed off as Yashoda's, and every CARE URL is quarantined in other_profiles. Do not contact him at Somajiguda without confirming first. Band is Low rather than High even though two official domains agree on his identity, because they disagree on his employer, and the row is about the Yashoda affiliation. NOT RECORDED, deliberately: a facebook.com/americanoncology post describing him as 'Consultant Surgical Oncologist at American Oncology Institute' - that is the hospital's own Facebook account, not his, and it points to a still earlier affiliation; and medicallearninghub.com/faculty/dr-yugandra-reddy, which uses the different spelling 'Yugandra' and could not be tied to him. One directory (Practo-derived) misstates his DNB as being from Basaveswara Medical College, Chitradurga; both first-party hospital sites say Basavatarakam Indo-American Cancer Hospital, Hyderabad, so the directory is wrong.
